description: Regression tickets added after the clarification and sufficiency changes. Kept separate from support_tickets.json so the original 20-ticket results stay comparable across versions. Expected outcomes follow the outcome_policy in support_tickets.json and were set before these tickets were run; they must not be changed to match agent answers.

tickets.description: Staff cannot resolve intranet hostnames since the DNS migration, but connecting by IP address still works.
tickets.regression_target: Paraphrase of E-REL-004: a behavioral symptom without an error code, which the symptom extractor sometimes misses.

tickets.description: Our service returns HTTP 502 Bad Gateway for a few minutes after every deployment.
tickets.regression_target: Generic system name ('our service') with a specific symptom must not trigger clarification.

tickets.description: Users are sent back to the sign-in page right after they log in through SSO.
tickets.regression_target: Behavioral symptom (redirect loop) with no error text.

tickets.description: Uploading files larger than 10 MB fails with HTTP 413 Request Entity Too Large.
tickets.regression_target: Explicit status code; must stay grounded after the clarification step was added.

tickets.description: Several laptops on the third floor got 169.254 addresses and cannot reach the internet.
tickets.regression_target: Symptom given as an observation (an address range), not an error message.

tickets.description: The orders API times out because its queries wait on row locks held by a long-running report.
tickets.regression_target: Specific database lock symptom; checks the sufficiency rule still accepts it.

tickets.description: Grafana panels show 'No data' for Prometheus metrics after we upgraded node_exporter.
tickets.regression_target: Specific but undocumented: must fall back, not ask for clarification.

tickets.description: Screen sharing in Zoom shows a black window on macOS after the latest OS update.
Celery workers stop consuming tasks from the RabbitMQ queue after a broker restart.

tickets.regression_target: No system and no specific symptom.

tickets.description: We're seeing errors since this morning.
tickets.regression_target: Generic 'errors' with a time reference only.
Names a documented system but no symptom. Probes whether the specificity check overrides clarification just because the system name matches one document.

tickets.description: Please order a second monitor for my desk.
FYI: the office network will be down for maintenance on Saturday from 2 to 4 AM.
tickets.regression_target: Announcement that mentions an outage; must not be treated as a problem report.

tickets.description: Our Kafka Connect S3 sink writes empty Parquet files after the schema registry upgrade.
tickets.regression_target: Mentions S3 and files, which overlap the upload docs lexically; must not be answered from them.

tickets.description: Okta SCIM provisioning does not create accounts in Slack for new hires.
tickets.regression_target: Identity-adjacent wording overlaps the authentication docs, but provisioning is not documented.
